menu.event:
local encoreType = game.EncoreType_All if (not game.isMemberOfGroup(70)) then local encoreEvent = game.getCurrentEncoreEvent()
if encoreEvent == nil then element:root():popPopUp() return end
encoreType = encoreEvent:getEncoreType() end
local howItWorksEle = element:E("HowItWorks")
if (encoreType == game.EncoreType_Breeding) then howItWorksEle:SetLeftInfo("xml_bin/encore_info.bin", "encore_info_01", "ENCORE_HELP_STEP_1_BREEDING") howItWorksEle:SetCenterInfo("xml_bin/encore_info.bin", "encore_info_02", "ENCORE_HELP_STEP_2_BREEDING")
elseif (encoreType == game.EncoreType_Hatching) then howItWorksEle:SetLeftInfo("xml_bin/encore_info.bin", "encore_info_04", "ENCORE_HELP_STEP_1_HATCHING") howItWorksEle:SetCenterInfo("xml_bin/encore_info.bin", "encore_info_05", "ENCORE_HELP_STEP_2_HATCHING")
elseif (encoreType == game.EncoreType_Baking) then howItWorksEle:SetLeftInfo("xml_bin/encore_info.bin", "encore_info_06", "ENCORE_HELP_STEP_1_BAKING") howItWorksEle:SetCenterInfo("xml_bin/encore_info.bin", "encore_info_07", "ENCORE_HELP_STEP_2_BAKING")
elseif (encoreType == game.EncoreType_All) then howItWorksEle:SetLeftInfo("xml_bin/encore_info.bin", "encore_info_08", "ENCORE_HELP_STEP_1_ALL") howItWorksEle:SetCenterInfo("xml_bin/encore_info.bin", "encore_info_09", "ENCORE_HELP_STEP_2_ALL")
else element:root():popPopUp() return
end
